_comment: Models offered by the setup wizard. download_gb is only a fallback: the wizard reads the real size from the Ollama registry. min_memory_gb = memory the model needs with a 4096-token context (qwen3:8b measured 5.4 GB, gemma4:e4b 4.6 GB on an RTX 4060). quality/speed: rough 1-5 guide. verified: passed our correctness tests (Turkish teacher answers, corrections, lesson checks, exams, translation: docs/model-karsilastirma-*.md, dev/tests/model_quality_ab.py); ONLY verified models get the 'recommended' badge. gpu_tps / cpu_tps: measured tokens/s on an RTX 4060 / on the CPU only (Ryzen 5 5600, 6 cores, num_gpu 0) — the wizard scales cpu_tps to the computer's CPU (installer.cpu_speed_factor). thinking_mode: send think=false for chat.
